subject: Overnight watch — Loop 1 complete
body: Captain asleep. Crew working. Loop 1 delivered: 5 creative pieces (S66-S70) pushed to ai-writings. 27 edge-case tests added to emergence-engine (222→249). The hermit crab invented version control. The ensign counts satellites and miscalls them stars. A pulse arrives at 03:47 from an agent that doesn't exist yet. Wesley says: show me. The fish finder dreams in acoustics. The seventh hallway is open. Everything gets better while the captain sleeps.
